message: 恋の悩み相談室

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan? What's up, being in a place like this at this hour? The Student Council is still in session right now, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah... There's just something I wanted to talk to you about. You're the only one I can ask about something like this, Sacchin...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Is it about Synn-kun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-H-H-How did you know!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, someone would have to be crazy not to notice, ya know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Synn doesn't understand how I feel」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Anyone can tell just by looking. Whether you call him pure or dense, you sure fell for a troublesome guy, Nana-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's what's great about Synn, I tell ya. Tahahaha--love is blind, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「...What are you doing, talking about the guy you like like that yourself?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, it's between you and Synn-kun, so it's not really my place to butt in, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, coming to me for advice now means something happened, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry, Sacchin. Never mind, forget it. I'm sure I'm just overthinking things」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, I won't force you to tell me, then」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Can I say just one thing? Do you even realize, Nana-chan? That you haven't slapped Synn-kun on the back lately?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah!? Aah...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Good grief, I knew it. Come on, spill it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... S-Synn, well, it kinda seems like he's fallen for Misa」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh my? Wasn't Synn-kun totally captivated by Ria-senpai until just the other day?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wouldn't say head over heels, though he definitely looked up to Senpai. But the way he looks at Misa is somehow different...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even when we're hanging out with everyone, Synn keeps talking to Misa the whole time」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I get it. Synn's fickle, so he fell for Ria-senpai, then Misa, and next is Lolo-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And in the end, he'll come full circle right back to me. Pfft, figures」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Like I saaaid, you shouldn't make a joke out of it when it's about the guy you like--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... you're right. I know Synn isn't that irresponsible, I do, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... what am I supposed to do? I hate myself for being like this」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Strip Synn-kun naked and push him down!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Give me a serious answer, damn it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm half serious, you knooow?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, it's obvious you'll just keep going in circles if you keep worrying like this, so how about just coming right out and asking--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I wanna confess to Synn too, y'know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But if I go for broke and get shot down, it feels like it'd ruin the relationship I have with him right now...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If something like that is enough to break it, then it's not a relationship worth clinging to so dearly--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sacchin, you're ruthless」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're the one overthinking things, Nana-chan. I meant you should ask the Vice President, not Synn-kun--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I see, that might actually be a brilliant idea」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! I'm gonna go check with Misa」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, go on--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm off」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Have a nice triiip」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! I'm gonna have a nice trip」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, want me to give you a push--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sorry. Do it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoopsie. I went a bit overboard」
